setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Two 8-step channels play at 90 BPM through the test device. Channel 1 (MIDI channel 1) has pattern 1 (C, D, E, F on steps 1 to 4) as its Foundation anchor and pattern 2 (steps 5 and 7) as additions. Channel 2 (MIDI channel 2) has pattern 3, a single trig on step 5, as its Foundation anchor. Channel 1 has no Interlock leader yet. The norns shows channel 1's Rhythm page and the grid lights steps 1 to 5 and 7.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Select Interlock with E2 and press K3 to open the Interlock page for channel 1. This keeps channel 1's additions out of the way of another channel's anchors.
steps.title: Open Interlock

steps.caption: Select Leader and turn E3 once right to CH02. Channel 2 would lead channel 1; nothing changes until you apply.
steps.title: Choose the leader

steps.caption: Press K3. The footer reads APPLIED, Window is 0 and Status reads ON. Step 5 goes dark on the grid because channel 1's addition starts exactly on channel 2's anchor. Steps 1 to 4 and step 7 stay lit.
steps.title: Apply: channel 2 leads

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two loops sound, then tap Stop. Channel 1 plays steps 1 to 4 and step 7, and channel 2 plays its anchor on step 5 on MIDI channel 2. Nothing from channel 1 sounds on step 5.
steps.title: Only the coincidence is removed

steps.caption: The lesson above is complete; the next four steps are edge cases. Tap Play. While it plays, select Window, turn E3 twice right to 2 and press K3. The footer reads NEXT CYCLE: playback is still running, so Window 2 is queued and starts at the next loop.
steps.title: Edge case: widen the window while playing

steps.caption: Window 2 is still queued. Turn E3 back to 0 as a new draft and press K2: the draft is discarded and Rhythm returns. Press K3 to reopen Interlock: Window still reads 2, the accepted value, not the discarded 0.
steps.title: Edge case: a later draft is discarded

steps.caption: After a few loops press Stop. The strip shows every loop played whole: the first loops with step 7, then without it once Window 2 took effect. The grid now shows steps 1 to 4.
steps.title: Edge case: the window takes over at the loop boundary

steps.caption: Select channel 2 (grid (2,1)). The screen shows channel 2's Merge Shape list, ready to set a leader for it.
steps.title: Select channel 2

steps.caption: Open Rhythm and then Interlock for channel 2: turn E2 to the row and press K3 each time. The header reads INTERLOCK CH02.
steps.title: Open channel 2's Interlock

steps.caption: Select Leader and turn E3 once right to CH01. Channel 2 already leads channel 1, so this would make a chain.
steps.title: Make channel 1 its leader

steps.caption: Press K3 to apply. The footer reads INVALID CHANNEL IS A LEADER: channel 2 already leads channel 1, so it cannot follow channel 1, and nothing changes.
steps.title: Edge case: a leader chain is refused

steps.caption: Press K2 to discard the draft and select channel 1 (grid (1,1)); the screen shows its Merge Shape list. Play two loops: Window 2 still applies, so channel 1 plays steps 1 to 4 and channel 2 plays step 5.
steps.title: The refusal changes nothing

title: Leave room around a leader’s anchors
